## Inworld TTS-1.5 Max API

Inworld TTS-1.5 Max is a text-to-speech model by Inworld, available on the Venice API as `tts-inworld-1-5-max`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Inworld TTS-1.5 Max is the higher-quality tier of Inworld's TTS-1.5 speech model, made for expressive delivery in games, companions and voice agents. It offers 14 voices and returns WAV audio.

### Inworld TTS-1.5 Max API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tts-inworld-1-5-max` | Standard | Anonymized | $12.50 / 1M chars |

### Inworld TTS-1.5 Max specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Inworld |
| Released | Apr 17, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Voices | 14 |
| Formats | wav |

### How to use the Inworld TTS-1.5 Max API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/speech` with `"model": "tts-inworld-1-5-max"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/speech \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "tts-inworld-1-5-max",
    "input": "Private AI for everyone.",
    "voice": "Alex",
    "response_format": "mp3"
  }' --output speech.mp3
```
